text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no experience regarding human overdosage with SOTYKTU. In case of an overdose, consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-222-1222) for additional overdosage management recommendations. The extent of deucravacitinib elimination by hemodialysis was small (5.4% of dose per dialysis treatment), and thus, hemodialysis for treatment of overdose with SOTYKTU is limited.
